# Delete your account

- Route: `/delete-account`
- Kind: `page`
- Category: `account`

## Summary

This page explains how to delete your account for the Media Manipulator app for Android and for media-manipulator.com. The app and the website are operated by CreaTV Ltd. and share one account, so deleting it removes it everywhere.

## Details

In the app
Open the app and sign in.
Go to Account, then Privacy & data.
Tap Delete my account.
Type DELETE MY ACCOUNT to confirm. You may be asked to sign in again.
On the website
Sign in at media-manipulator.com.
Open your Account page and choose the Privacy & data tab.
Choose Delete account and type DELETE MY ACCOUNT to confirm.
Open Privacy & data
If you cannot sign in
Email privacy@media-manipulator.com from the email address of your account and write that you want your account deleted. We verify that the request comes from the owner of the account and delete it within 30 days.
What is deleted
your account record, your settings and your sign-in;
your files, results and history, and your Darkroom, Motion and Aperture projects;
your saved voices;
the push notification tokens of your devices;
the analytics data linked to your account;
your Premium or Pro subscription, which is cancelled immediately.
What is kept, and for how long
a minimal deletion record with only a one-way hash of your account identifier and the date, for 30 days;
the log of your consent and opt-out choices, for five years, as the law requires us to be able to prove them;
payment records held by Stripe, our payment processor, for as long as the law requires;
crash reports held by Firebase Crashlytics, which Google removes after 90 days.
Deleting from the app or the website starts immediately. If a step cannot be completed, you are told, and you can write to us at the address above.
For everything we collect and how we use it, read the Privacy Policy.
